title: Attribute the full-rebuild compiler envelope without a second projection path

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Extend the existing GPU-100 relation-delta diagnostic, not production, so the unchanged compile_relation_blocks call is profiled directly. Attribute its real selected TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed reconstruction call and report the remaining compiler cumulative envelope as a bounded non-block residual. Keep the residual explicitly broader than pure edge discovery because it also contains Forest/Fourfold partition checks, edge admission, fact aggregation, signature/axis setup and receipt construction. Do not build or simulate an incremental backend.

ordinary_wall_timing_ms.interpretation: These remain ordinary full-rebuild timings. Their ratio is not an incremental speedup because no incremental implementation exists.

profiled_attribution_ms.interpretation: For this frozen profiled case, the selected TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed reconstruction accounts for about 3.88% of compile_relation_blocks cumulative profile time, while the conservatively defined non-block compiler envelope accounts for about 96.12%. The latter is not pure edge-scan time: it includes partition checks, global edge discovery/admission, relation-digest work, fact aggregation, axis/signature setup and receipt construction. cProfile distorts wall time, so these fractions are attribution evidence only.

measurement.fail_closed: The partial code-plane case is refused with 'relation compilation requires complete endpoint planes; code=partial'.
measurement.finding: GPU-101 falsifies further constructor-first optimization as the next priority for this frozen delta-rebuild case. The measured selected-block reconstruction is only about 3.88% of profiled compiler cumulative time; about 96.12% remains in the broader non-block compiler envelope. This justifies refining a narrow seam inside the existing compiler front half before any production delta API is proposed. It does not prove an incremental speedup, memory win, Tensor-over-Forest advantage, or that edge scanning alone consumes 96.12%.

result.summary: GPU-101 closes with exact hosted schema-v2 evidence. In the frozen 512x16 one-coordinate delta case, selected block reconstruction is about 3.88% of profiled compile_relation_blocks cumulative time and the conservatively named non-block compiler envelope is about 96.12%. Production code remains unchanged; the next bounded research target moves into the existing compiler front half instead of adding another constructor optimization or delta backend.
